## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-06T07:07Z · head `e594200ca541e02d43b11a7da1d15ed29d55f26b`

Seat `domain:ui#2` reviewed the diff of its own dispatch (claim 6677492515 on #30786, card thread `session_01L9qibxnBUdHmaTxkkEtU5p`; the same seat dispatched and reviews, the code is the thread's).

1. **Shape:** 13 files, +352 / -62, all under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` plus one root `.changeset/`. `authoredObjectBuffer.ts` holds one reading for every type in the spec's `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES` (the set the REST read translates by): the stored `draft` layer as-is, else `overlay ?? code` for an object and `effective ?? code` for the others; a served draft with no `draft` layer installs nothing. `ResourceEditPage.tsx` uses it at load, save refresh and publish refresh; reset/discard are byte-identical for non-objects. Studio's import is untouched. `Part of #30786`.
2. **Premise measured:** live zh-CN stack on `origin/main` `9b24f3ca`: view, app and dashboard each store translated text on the second save (table in the body); page, report, action and book reproduce the same way. `/layers` `effective` is served untranslated and equals `code` in all three, so the published half stays source text.
3. **Gates / check-runs:** 55 check runs on this head, 44 success, 11 skipped, 0 red. 35 derived gates exit 0 (reconciled `--ran`, 0 UNRUN); app-shell type-check 0; metadata-admin + three studio-design suites 732 files / 7,726 passed. Ablation of the gate back to object-only reds 9 of 12 new cases.
4. **Accepted deviation:** nine existing suites' client doubles now serve the stored `draft` layer beside their readable draft, as the server does for an admitted author; no assertion changed.
5. **Out of scope / Skills-docs:** Wanted 3 (the two plugin-designer pages) stays on #30786 for PR 2. Studio editors and `EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx` that seed from the served draft are filed as #30859. `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Skills-docs:` not owed. Position, permission set, dataset and picklist are NOT MEASURED live (named in the body).
6. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --branch`: 0 of 13 paths governed, 414 changed lines → Tier S path, no human approval owed. `Clause-②: no` (no export added from a published entry): no contract review owed. Landing on the maintainer's standing word 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」 (2026-10-30T14:20Z) and 「ui 车道跟进一下 3小时内没更新的pr和已派发的issue，接手处理。」 (2026-11-06T05:20Z): relay `pr_ready`, then `automerge_enable`. On merge the card stays open for PR 2 (`Part of`).
